ModMetaData.name: Add windows to your house！
ModMetaData.author: Lin
ModMetaData.description:
Add windows to your house！This mod adds half walls and the sliding windows that go on them.
- Half walls: a waist-high wall nothing crosses. Like a wall it closes a room, but it holds up no roof - and the day comes in over its top. - Windows: fit one on top of a half wall (the button on the wall, or the Structure menu) and a colonist builds it. One half wall takes one window. Once a window is in, that half wall counts as a real wall: it closes a room and holds a roof. - Two solid boards in a frame, no glass. Open and close a window by hand: a colonist slides the boards apart or shut; a half-open window carries on from where it stopped. - Light: shut, the window blocks light like a wall; open, it lets the day in. How bright it gets and how far it reaches follow how far the boards are apart, and a lamp's light passes through an open window too. The light only goes to the darker side - a window never glows back into the sunlight it faces. - A window set across the wall (sideways) is always open to the light: its boards slide along the wall and cover nothing. - Ventilation: shut, the window seals the room like a brick wall; open, heat passes through in proportion to how far the boards have moved, up to a vent's rate when it is fully open. On an orbital map an open window also lets the vacuum in. - HP, build time, opening speed, flammability and beauty match a door of the same material; a wooden window costs 10 wood, two fifths of a wooden door. Deconstruct the window and half of that comes back; take the wall down with the window still in it and the glazing is broken out instead, returning a quarter.
REQUIRES, in this order: Harmony, IsoRim Waylith, and IsoRim ProjectZ (the base mod this is built on - install it in Mods/ as well, from the same author). RimWorld 1.7.
给房子开一扇窗！本 mod 添加半墙和装在半墙上的推拉窗。
- 半墙：齐腰高、过不去的墙。像墙一样能围出房间，但不撑屋顶 —— 日光从墙头上越过。 - 窗户：在半墙上装窗（半墙上的按钮，或建造菜单），小人建造；一堵半墙只装一扇窗。装上窗之后，那格半墙就算真正的墙： 能围出房间、能撑屋顶。 - 两扇实心木板加边框，没有玻璃。窗要手动开合：小人把木板推开或拉回；关到一半被打断，下次接着来。 - 透光：关着时像墙一样挡光；开着时把日光放进屋里，亮度和照得多远都跟着木板推开的程度走，开着的窗也放灯光过去。 光只往暗的那一侧透，不会朝对着的太阳那一面发光。 - 侧着放（横跨墙）的窗永远透光：它的木板是沿墙滑的，本来就挡不住开口。 - 通风：关着时像砖墙一样密封；开着时按木板推开的程度通风，全开时约等于一个通风孔。在轨道环境下开窗还会放真空进来。 - 血量、建造时间、开关速度、易燃性、美观都和同材料的门一致；木窗 10 木头，是同材料门成本的五分之二。 拆窗本身返还一半；连墙一起拆则是把窗砸下来，返还四分之一。
**必须**按顺序装：Harmony、IsoRim Waylith，以及 **IsoRim ProjectZ**（本 mod 依赖的基座，需要另外放进 Mods 文件夹）。 RimWorld 1.7。
